record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: R55 is now contained on ggen-marketplace default after exact owning-court, Vacuity, and broad real-ggen qualification. The verifier bootstrap dead-zone is also contained as default-owned two-mode court substrate. Newly reachable frontier: use admitted producer-owned R51/R52/R55 semantics to move consumer breadth from independently-ready 1/10 upward by manufacturing target-local adapters and evidence-return receipts, then measure causal downstream unlocks. Preserve R54 causal/yield measurement as orthogonal evidence production. Do not count structural fanout as observed leverage.
